Narika has a die which is known to be biased so that the probability of throwing a 6 on any
throw is . She uses an approximating distribution to calculate the probability of obtaining no
6s in 450 throws. Find the percentage error in using the approximating distribution for this
calculation.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Johan claims that a certain six-sided die is biased so that it shows a 6 less often than it would if
the die were fair. In order to test this claim, the die is thrown 25 times and it shows a 6 on only
2 throws. Test at the 10% significance level whether Johan’s claim is justified.
